column1: # docs/PREFLIGHT-TIMING.tsv — where the static pre-flight's wall clock goes.
# GENERATED by `uv run python tools/time_preflight.py --tsv docs/PREFLIGHT-TIMING.tsv`.
# Re-takeable on any commit; nothing reads this file, so a stale row misleads a
# reader and fails nothing. Re-take before quoting a number from it.
# TAKEN: 2026-09-07, re-take for Lane B iteration 10 @ a2b06aac4 (the take ran
# on the dirty tree that became that commit), worktree fft-monorepo-testaudit,
# Godot 4.8.dev.custom_build. 84 steps, 157.98 s total (2.6 min).
# ⚠️ THE BOX WAS NOT QUIET. Two other sessions (fft-monorepo-746,
# fft-monorepo-pfrank) were running godot tests + their own pre-flight during
# the take, so every absolute number here is INFLATED. The ranking is not a
# contention artifact — the top step is 62 s against a median of ~0.05 s — but
# do not quote the totals as a clean measurement.
# ANOMALIES ON THE TAKE — BOTH EXPLAINED, NEITHER A REGRESSION:
#  - check_adr_classification.py exit 1 (line 607): NOT contention. That step
#    regenerates docs/adr/AUDIT.md in place via gen_adr_audit.py; the audited
#    tool edits moved per-ADR citation counts, so the first pass wrote the
#    regenerated file and reported "STALE AUDIT.md" (exit 1). Subsequent runs
#    are rc 0, regeneration verified idempotent, AUDIT.md committed in
#    a2b06aac4.
#  - gen_activity_taxonomy.py exit 2 x2 (lines 153/156): rc 2 = GenError
#    "could not reach a destination"; a 0.01 s step is a startup failure under
#    contention. 3/3 clean re-runs with the pre-flight's own invocation
#    ((cd tools && uv run python gen_activity_taxonomy.py --check)).
# WHY THIS IS SUITE COST. `run_tests_parallel.py` shells out to
# `run_all_tests.sh --preflight-only` and WAITS. The pre-flight is serial time at
# the head of every full run: it does not overlap the N-way pool, so a minute here
# is a minute of wall clock at any N.
# AUDITED: `unittest test_check_addon_portability` — outcome: MAKE IT CHEAPER.
# 253.06 s -> 62.17 s (~4x): 13 of 69 arms re-ran the same whole-tree walk on an
# unchanged tree; the clean-tree arms now share ONE walk cached on a tree
# signature, and the seeded arms walk fresh so the cache cannot swallow a seed.
# Three full walks remain: 2 in-process (clean + one seeded cache-miss) and 1
# as-shipped subprocess (Arm4c, the __main__ exit-code proof).
# NEXT UNAUDITED TOP ROW: `unittest test_check_lattice_scene` (43.42 s here).
